offering_description.value: Provides inflight broadband internet, entertainment and voice/messaging services to business aircraft operators. Sells and installs onboard antennas and equipment and delivers connectivity through air-to-ground and satellite networks.

primary_products.value: airborne antennas and avionics equipment; onboard routers and wireless systems; satellite terminals

primary_services.value: inflight internet connectivity; inflight entertainment; voice and messaging services; installation and maintenance support

customer_segment.value: B2B: business aircraft owners, operators, charter companies, fractional operators and aircraft OEMs/dealers; B2G: government and military aircraft operators

end_markets.value: business aviation; private jets; government and military aviation

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly or usage-based connectivity service plans for aircraft; product sales: avionics and antenna equipment sold to operators and OEMs; service fees: installation, maintenance and support

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys satellite capacity and operates air-to-ground network, selling connectivity to aircraft operators; OEM / manufacturer: designs and sells onboard equipment built with contract manufacturers, sold to operators and installers

geography_served.value: global: North America air-to-ground network plus satellite coverage worldwide for business aircraft

specialization.value: related lines: connectivity services, onboard equipment and inflight entertainment for business aviation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to aircraft operators and owners; partners / resellers: avionics dealers and installation shops, aircraft OEMs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC spectrum licenses and FAA aircraft equipment certification, foreign telecom regulators

notes: Commercial aviation business was sold to Intelsat in 2020; described as business aviation only.
